7275.title: Non-ASCII capitalization changes path search matching
7275.rootCauseOneLine: Unicode uppercase enables smart-case matching across path-search branches, excluding lowercase filenames.
7275.proposedFix: Normalize queries without ASCII uppercase at the shared path-matcher boundary, retaining ASCII smart-case and covering plain and structured queries.
7275.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in a second clean trusted checkout. Matcher-level reproduction, not a live API or macOS UI verification. Full script and output embedded inline per reports repository policy.
